units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 5:5:2">Y. Erub. V, 22ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>לח׳ בתים וכ׳</he> (the handle of an axe wedged in between two buildings) was intended to support the houses, v. <cite ref="D00669"><he>דִּיסְתְּקָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 32b:11">Ber. 32ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 5:1">Yalk. Josh. 5</cite>.

senses.gloss: fastening, stringent measures for the protection of the law.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 83b:15">Keth. 83ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>חכמים עשו ח׳ לדבריהם וכ׳</he> the scholars protected their own enactments more than the biblical laws.
<cite ref="Eruvin 3a:26">Erub. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>סוכה דאורייתא לא בעי ח׳ וכ׳</he> the law of Succah being Biblical requires no protection, but that about &c.
